en:
Gahhh, I can't focus! And if I can't focus,
I can't stay on top of my inventions!

You get it!? My focus can shape the
course of history!

<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Miu for a while?
Even though it might not be safe to ask...

It's pointless for me to keep workin', so I'll
take a break and spend time with you!

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
